verdict.rationale: Radar's own docs say it identifies fraudulent accounts. Radar Pro adds detection of 'multi-account, free trial, and pay-as-you-go abuse', which covers fake/multi-account creation and some policy abuse inside the same Radar system. Account takeover is never mentioned, and there is no detail on how these non-payment events are scored or managed (rules, reviews, lists). missing for 10: account takeover protection, explicit promo/coupon abuse coverage, documentation of scoring and review workflows for non-checkout events, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, protection extends beyond checkout — account takeover, fake account creation, promo and policy abuse are scored and managed in the same system

citations.quote: detect and prevent transaction fraud, and identify fraudulent accounts
Advanced protection against emerging fraud threats and customer abuse. Detect multi-account, free trial, and pay-as-you-go abuse.
